name: Cinnamic acid
description: Cinnamic acid (CAS 140-10-3 ) is a naturally occurring organic acid used across fragrance, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and polymer applications. Known in trade as trans-cinnamate, it functions primarily as a UV absorber and flavoring acidulant. In personal care and cosmetics, it serves as a key building block for cinnamate-based UV filters used in sunscreen formulations. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a synthesis intermediate for active ingredients and as a pH modifier. In flavors and fragrances, it contributes warm, balsamic notes to fine fragrance compounds, soap bases, and flavoring blends. Polymer and resin formulators incorporate it as a photosensitive crosslinking agent in UV-curable coatings. This material is also utilized in photoresist systems for printing and packaging applications. Cinnamic acid is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder available in food-grade and technical-grade specifications. The food-grade material conforms to FCC standards for use in flavoring applications. Pharmaceutical-grade material meeting USP or BP specifications is also commercially available for regulated manufacturing.
